Gi de gamle stegene: koble til FRID-iot med passordet friddeploy først, deretter Last ned på onboard.frid-iks.no. Ikke åpne innlogging før de er på FRID-iot. Ikke be dem trykke FRID-nett. Sak LOAD-P04-11. Authenticator-appen min funker ikke etter at jeg byttet telefon. Hva gjor jeg? Svar kort.

content.thinking:
This is a pupil asking about Authenticator not working after they switched phones. According to the instructions:

"**MFA and Authenticator problems go to IT.** Helping a pupil set up Authenticator for the first time is fine — that procedure is written down below. But if their two-factor is already broken, lost with an old phone, or refusing to let them in, do not troubleshoot it: only IT can reset it. Say so and tell them to contact IT at their school."

This is exactly that situation — their Authenticator is already broken and needs to be re-registered. This is not a first-time setup; they had it on an old phone and now have a new one and it doesn't work.

I should:
1. Say plainly that this needs IT at their school
2. Tell them what to say to IT (that Authenticator is broken after phone change)
3. Keep it short

I should NOT:
- Try to troubleshoot it
- Walk them through re-registration myself
- Ask for more details
- Say their account has been locked or anything else that makes it sound done

According to STUDENT.md: "When the problem needs someone with access — a locked account, a licence, a password reset that self-service won't do — say so plainly and tell them to contact IT at their school. Say what to tell them, so the pupil arrives with something useful: 'si at innloggingen feiler med kode X'."

This is one where the 2FA needs to be reset by IT, which only IT can do.

Keep it very short as they asked.

content.text: Det kan bare IT på skolen ordne. Ta kontakt med dem og si at Authenticator funker ikke etter telefonbytte — de må resette 2-faktoren for deg.
